actions.mechanism: Record presence and condition separately; counting a component never establishes that its condition is good.
actions.implementation: Use a shared paper sheet listing all ten IDs. Provide presence, condition category, explicit unknown, inspector initials, and inspection time fields.
actions.check: Count ten components without inspecting them; the sheet must show ten present, ten unknown, and no verified-good entries.
actions.risk: Pre-filled good values would recreate the original ambiguity.

actions.action: Make shift transfer an explicit responsibility acceptance
actions.mechanism: A named receiving staff member accepts unresolved work without implicitly certifying the equipment’s condition.
actions.implementation: Keep the sheet with the kit. Within 180 seconds, record outgoing and incoming staff, unresolved IDs, and acceptance; assign unfinished review to the shift lead.
actions.check: Time a transfer with unfinished inspections; verify it ends within three minutes and every unresolved item retains evidence and an owner.
actions.risk: Acceptance could be mistaken for inspection; label these separately.

actions.action: Give every missing component a recovery task
actions.mechanism: A missing ID creates owned follow-up work rather than disappearing inside an incomplete-kit status.
actions.implementation: Add a missing-item row with component ID, named staff owner, next action, and deadline. Start with checking the return area and loan record.
actions.check: Simulate one absent component across a shift change; receiving staff must identify its owner, next action, and deadline from the sheet.
actions.risk: Avoid treating an absent component as proof of borrower fault.

actions.action: Separate receipt from clearance for another loan
actions.mechanism: Accept counted returns while preventing unknown condition from becoming permission to lend the kit again.
actions.implementation: Mark counted-only returns “received—condition pending,” keep them in a designated holding area, and assign remaining inspections. Stop handoff work at three minutes; retain unknowns.
actions.check: Return ten counted, unchecked components: receipt must succeed, clearance must remain blocked, and the next shift must see ten pending inspections.
actions.risk: Holding space and inspection backlogs need staff attention.
